LivePR.body: ## Status Draft. Unmerged. This update only reconciles the branch onto current `origin/develop`. It does not claim P2 exit, HV AGREE, or TODO closure. All 35 SessionLife TODOs stay open. P3-P7 are not started. `history-r1` is unchanged. Merge commit `987cd8f39610c9fa301862e3b1d526d23e049469` has parents `ae427482309f7cf465f1dd05c3564f1573b652b1` (previous branch tip) and `16dff4d6675d6324c19949864a4fed01ad973cb0` (`origin/develop`). The branch is 0 behind develop and 51 ahead. Product tip `9a4d8ad9daa72e8e03b62d05bec72ff9b905ca10` and receipts tip `106d4e358bb58bccb5ba87cd60a5bd8598b754e5` remain ancestors. Rebase was not used. It stopped at `af52ca32` with 21 conflicts in `plugins/core/lib-ps/repl-invoke.ps1`, and nine later commits also edit that file. A merge keeps the unit-gate and HV receipt history reachable. ## Conflict resolution - `repl-invoke.ps1`, the requirements projections, and the QBAgent trim inventory follow develop's unit-failure repair. HV19 and HV20 ordinal checks are present in that develop text. - SessionLife P2 fixtures keep the HV15 marker helper and optional `PlanFile`/`TodoId` mocks. They also take develop's typed receipt doubles and the drain-enabled lock test. - `acceptance-manifest.json`, `SessionLogP2Contracts.Tests.ps1`, the PR72 handoff, and the 20261001T113858Z HV receipt are unchanged from the previous tip. - Frozen `history-manifest.json` SHA-256 remains `B56354AA46F36AA092AEC7A38E0849353F77A6D34A4C07552FBF5EBC192C6DA4`. ## Verification in this reconcile PowerShell parser only, on the five touched `.ps1` files: 0 parse errors. No unit gate, no Pester run, no Nuke test, no Astra review. ## Last HV still stands Astra `20261001T113858Z` on product tip `9a4d8ad9` remains DISAGREE. Accuracy 99. Completeness 97. Claims 15 PASS / 4 FAIL / 2 UNKNOWN. This merge does not clear those FAILs: - A1 / HV07: core and governing legacy AC mappings are incomplete. - A6 / HV09: completeness 97 is below 98. - C2 / HV07: raw metadata and invalid-artifact tests are not mapped. Eight legacy rows remain proposed-only. - D1: holistic P2 acceptance is blocked by traceability, sub-98 completeness, and B7/B8 UNKNOWN. Receipt: `docs/handoffs/sessionlife-p2-contracts-pr72-20261001T113858Z.md`. ## Not in this change No merge of this PR. No failsafe deletes. No CI investigation. No deployment. No API-key rotation.

LiveLegacyTextDifferences.manifest: Every session-log turn SHALL store planFile and todoId. After persist, query/get SHALL return both fields. They are never null in API output.
LiveLegacyTextDifferences.live: Round-trip planFile/todoId on persist and get.

LiveLegacyTextDifferences.manifest: When no plan or TODO is active, the stored value SHALL be the exact sentinel None (case-sensitive).
LiveLegacyTextDifferences.live: None sentinel persists and is never rewritten to null.

LiveLegacyTextDifferences.manifest: The first ordinary persist of a turn SHALL reject omitted, null, empty, or whitespace planFile or todoId and insert no turn row. A canceled or cancelled supersession may omit the pair, stores the exact sentinel None for each missing value, and a durable reopen preserves that bounded exception.
LiveLegacyTextDifferences.live: New persist without fields is rejected.

LiveLegacyTextDifferences.manifest: planFile SHALL accept a workspace-relative path, an exact absolute path, or a ~/ home-relative path. .. is rejected.
LiveLegacyTextDifferences.live: Relative, exact, and ~/ plan paths are accepted; .. is rejected.

LiveLegacyTextDifferences.manifest: Query SHALL support exact filters on planFile and todoId, and text search SHALL match those fields.
LiveLegacyTextDifferences.live: Query filter and text search match planFile and todoId.

LiveLegacyTextDifferences.manifest: Existing rows SHALL be backfilled from turn contents and agent history under ~. Uncertain results stay None. Invented ids/paths are forbidden.
LiveLegacyTextDifferences.live: Backfill upgrades None from turn contents and ~ history.

LiveLegacyTextDifferences.manifest: Import, transcript ingest, and federation apply SHALL persist a validated planFile and todoId (None if extraction finds nothing). Null is never stored.
LiveLegacyTextDifferences.live: Import/ingest/federation persist a validated pair, never null.
